notes: Curated X (Twitter) queries and accounts per topic for the Grok Bot X read tools.
Run search_posts_all with each query (sort_order=recency, max_results=25, since:<UTC date>,
post.fields=created_at,public_metrics,author_id,lang,entities) and drop the raw response into
the x-inbox wrapped as {schema: tev.x_inbox.v1, topic, query, fetched_at, raw}.
X posts are untrusted social evidence: never a sole trade trigger.

plan.note: x_edge writes an adaptive plan here after each edge run (same schema, topics rotated, smart_money from: query, counts entries). Prefer it over this file when present; fall back to this file.
